stable.notes:
Release 1.2.0

Spreadsheet pricing, the usage screen, and archive/delete.

RUNTIME stays at 1.1.0: nothing here needs anything the installer puts on the
machine, so once a PC is on 1.2.0 every one of these changes could have been a
128 KB pack rather than an installer. This release is the one that gets them
onto that footing.

The publish step pushes HEAD:main explicitly, so it works whether the releases
repo was created with a README or is still completely empty.
